shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'index.html' | head -200"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -i -C 3 'dashboard|grid|drag|chart' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,220p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && sed -n '1,200p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '1,160p' src/main.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc "ls -1 | head -40; rg -n 'dashkit|@gravity-ui/charts' package-lock.json pnpm-lock.yaml yarn.lock 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit @gravity-ui/charts'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit'
/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh dashkit DashKit'
/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh dashkit DashKit'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; rg -n -C 3 'Required setup|styles|DashKit|plugins|layout|config|onLayout' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -180; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json | head -90; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '"'^###|DashKitDnDWrapper|ActionPanel|registerPlugins|CustomPlugin|styles.css'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -100; sed -n '330,490p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKitDnDWrapper/index.d.ts; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm | rg 'ActionPanel|DnDWrapper' | head"

/bin/bash -lc "npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 peerDependencies --json; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.d.ts; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.d.ts; rg -n -C 3 'import.*css|@gravity-ui/dashkit.*css|dashkit.*scss' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1.0.0 peerDependencies --json; rg -n 'ActionPanelProps|ActionPanelItem' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/types.d.ts; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/types.d.ts; rg -n -C 2 'CSS API|dashkit.*css|CSS|styles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | tail -50"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 peerDependencies --json; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 version'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0'

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh charts Chart; rg -n -C 3 'Required setup|Chart|line|bar-x|data|theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -160; rg -n 'styles|dashkit' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -50; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'import.*css|\\.css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/{DashKit,GridLayout,DashKitDnDWrapper}; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/index.js; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/types/Config.d.ts 2>/dev/null; rg -n 'export interface Config|type Config =|interface ConfigItem|interface ConfigLayout' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared -g '*.d.ts'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/types/config.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/settings.d.ts 2>/dev/null; rg -n 'interface Settings|gridLayout' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings -g '*.d.ts' | head -30; rg -n 'import .*css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components -g '*.js' | head -20; rg -n 'export.*Button|ButtonProps|TextProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -g '*.d.ts' | head"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/plugin.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/common.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md | sed -n '13,56p'; rg -n 'export.*Chart|ChartProps|type ChartData' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '191,235p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; rg -n 'interface AddNewItemOptions|type AddNewItemOptions' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/config.d.ts'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short; rg -n 'colsByBreakpoint|cols:' src/App.tsx; rg -n 'base-(positive|warning|info)-light|color-base-generic|text-positive' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles -g '*.css' | head -20; rg -n 'react-grid-layout/css|react-resizable/css|GridLayout.css|grid-layout' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components -g '*.js' | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/GridLayout.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/GridLayout.d.ts | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true})\"; git diff --stat; git diff -- package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short; git diff --check; npm run build >/tmp/dashboard-build.log && tail -8 /tmp/dashboard-build.log; node -e \"require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true})\""
